items.note: Groups ran brainwriting with an LLM added and the authors evaluated the ideation process and resulting solution space, plus an LLM idea-evaluation engine against 3 expert and 6 novice raters; the abstract does not say whether a no-AI brainwriting condition exists, so the next stage must check for a comparison arm (may be system_paper_no_comparison).

Title suggests an experiment varying the mediation mode of group collaboration with an AI co-ideation peer (same team as the CHI 2024 group-AI brainwriting paper, c904); abstract not reachable (SSRN 403, Crossref and Semantic Scholar have none, OpenAlex rate-limited, web search found nothing), so classified from title and notes only.

Controlled experiments with 600 Indian and US participants who wrote constructive comments on divisive threads alone or with an LLM, with comments rated for constructiveness; 600 is the total across experiments, and the search notes say the writing experiment randomized 104 people and also reports similarity and lexical diversity across comments (across_people), which the abstract does not mention.

Between-subjects study (N=24) comparing an AI design-ideation interface that reads sketches plus concurrent speech with sketches alone; reported outcomes are perceived alignment and creativity support, so output scoring is doubtful and the sample is below 50.

Research-in-progress pilot comparing voice with (presumably) text interaction with generative AI in rule-bound co-creation tasks, with output quality scored (voice lowered it); sample size not given and whether the task is creative is doubtful (the abstract calls it rule-bound).

48 participants generated and selected ideas with one of two facilitator chatbots (structured versus adaptive process), so the comparison is between AI configurations with no no-AI arm; the abstract does not say whether idea quality was scored, and the sample is below 50.

30 designers did bio-inspired design tasks in three modes (BID only, ChatGPT only, BID plus ChatGPT) and creativity was measured only with EEG task-related power, not by scoring the designs; also below 50.

CHI 2026 extended abstract that manipulates interaction depth and suggestion phrasing in AI-assisted narrative planning against a human-only baseline and reports more original story ideas with AI; preliminary results, sample size not stated.

System paper with a small user study comparing a node-based graph interface for chaining generative models with a conversational interface for creative writing; creativity of outputs does not appear to be scored and the sample is small, so it may end up as a system paper or a sub-50 study.

Experiment with 90 participants generating new venture ideas with or without an AI system, scoring the number of creative, novel, and useful ideas and average novelty; AOM 2022 proceedings abstract that does not name the AI tool, so whether it is generative AI must be checked (pre-ChatGPT).
